workflow: Denaturing top-down proteomics (dTDP) aims to delineate proteoforms in cells with high throughput.
A data-dependent acquisition (DDA) method was employed.
The TopPIC (top-down mass spectrometry-based proteoform identification and characterization) software was applied for proteoform IDs.
The mzML files were then processed by the TopFD (Top-down mass spectrometry feature detection) tool for spectral deconvolution.
differential: The study focuses on method comparison (MU vs CMP vs SP3) and proteoform identification rather than a biological differential expression design.
